Located in Vatnajökull National Park in South Iceland, this incredible winter experience departs from Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon . The blue ice cave is a breathtaking marvel of nature and a must-see for anyone visiting Iceland during the winter months . It stands as one of Iceland’s most renowned attractions, allowing you to explore the interior of an ancient glacier that houses this natural wonder. Inside, you’ll encounter varying shades of blue ice and remarkable formations that will leave you in awe. We have departures daily in winter from Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon. With expert guides, explore this magical, ever-changing world and experience the unforgettable beauty hidden beneath the glacier. You have the opportunity to step inside to see vibrant blue walls and stunning ice formations, shaped by nature each year. Each ice cave is unique at a time, making your experience one of the kind. Book with us for a guided experience , with necessary gears provided, and glacier guides who will lead you safely through this breathtaking ice wonderland, sharing their local knowledge and ensuring you capture every magical moment. Don’t miss this chance to explore a natural wonder like no other! This tour is operated by Crystal Cave Tours .
